concept: spicy weakness person very spicy level
author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Large two-tongued fireball at the upper left bursting toward a round head whose mouth gapes open at the left, with a dazed eye, following the reference's fireball, open-mouthed head and eye. The current drawing had a small sweat-drop instead of fire and a frown arc below the head, so it read as a sad or nervous face, not a spicy reaction.
omissions: The reference's X eye is a dot (an X needs 12+ units of clearance inside the head), and the shoulder arc is omitted so the fireball can be large at 8 spacing.
